method: Executed differential: four oracle drivers link the Linux x86_64 Release install openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 (g++ 14.4.0 -O2 -DNDEBUG, Arrow C++ 23.0.1) on ibminode06, each run twice in a clean environment with byte-identical records; the Rust tests transcribe the records and read the Parquet files the executed library wrote, plus the retained C++-written TOPP fixture bundles. ParquetFilter is transcribed from its upstream class test.
evidence_tier: 1 (executed differential; ParquetFilter tier 3, source review of the class test)
reference_tools: ../oracle/F1a-arrow, ../oracle/F1a-arrow2, ../oracle/F1a-protein, ../oracle/F1a-features (driver.cpp, node.sh, run.sh), ../oracle/integ-F-psmarrowio (driver.cpp, remote_run.sh, run.sh; wave-4 integration)

external_reference_note: The oracle drivers are C++ and stay outside the repository; their records were copied verbatim into tests/data/arrow_parquet/ (hashes above), and results/hashes.txt of each oracle hashes the driver, the built binary, libOpenMS.so and every file it wrote. The C++-written pia_*.parquet files embed a fresh uuid and creation_date per run, so the two runs of oracle part 3 differ in those files only; the records are identical.
psm_arrow_io_note: PSMArrowIO (wave-4 integration, INTEG-F): tests/psm_arrow_io.rs ports every section of PSMArrowIO_test.cpp (tier 3) and imports the C++-written test-data fixtures IDMerger_idparquet_input1/2.idparquet (already listed under fixtures), which topp/CMakeLists.txt:178 at test-data 0cb15f2 records as written by IDFileConverter from topp/IDMerger_1_input1.idXML (sha256 3621364be45a069a2bd4224832231e1608528c098accdc1ede1aa83003de3cdd) and topp/IDMerger_1_input2.idXML (sha256 a7ece5d0cec93d55c9b43ed53a456222c8f73035be78a6995b069ae742d390eb); the expected identifications are transcribed from those two idXML files, and the retained topp/IDMerger_idparquet_output.idXML (sha256 0fa0bf1a78d3dab97b0474cf62bdaa5f47451ad0224a253a338df7bac42d1c73, the C++ import merged by IDMerger, which sorts hits) shows the same hits. Tier 1: ../oracle/integ-F-psmarrowio links the Linux x86_64 Release install openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 on ibminode06 (run twice, identical records): PSMArrowIO::importFromParquet of the four C++-written idparquet fixtures and of the Release build's own exportToParquet bundles of the class test's minimal, decoy and multi-rank sets, field for field (tests/data/psm_arrow_io/cpp_release_records.tsv, cpp_release_stderr.txt and export_*/, verbatim; the bundles embed a fresh uuid and creation_date per run).
